model_annotation: The figure displays two line plots comparing the training rewards of two models, Llama-On-Policy and Llama-LUFFY, across different training sets. The top plot, titled "Easy Training Set," shows training rewards on the y-axis ranging from 0.0 to 0.4, plotted against the number of steps on the x-axis, which ranges from 0 to 500. The Llama-On-Policy-Easy model (blue line) starts at a reward of approximately 0.0 and increases to a final value of around 0.38, with some fluctuations. The Llama-LUFFY-Easy model (red line) also starts at 0.0, rises to a peak of about 0.4, and then slightly declines, ending at approximately 0.39. The bottom plot, titled "Hard Training Set," has a y-axis ranging from 0.0 to 0.2. The Llama-On-Policy-Hard model (blue line) starts at 0.0, increases to a peak of about 0.03, and then decreases to nearly 0.0. The Llama-LUFFY-Hard model (red line) starts at 0.0, rises to a peak of about 0.18, and then fluctuates around 0.18-0.20. Both plots use a linear scale for the x-axis and show training rewards in a non-linear fashion over steps.
